title: Backend Engineer
description: Join the platform team building payment orchestration services. You will own APIs written in TypeScript and Node.js, model data in SQL, improve latency and reliability, and write runbooks for on-call. We value idempotency, observability and careful incident follow-up. Redis and Docker experience is an advantage.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Build and maintain the customer-facing web shop and the in-store dashboards. You will work in React and TypeScript, care about accessibility and performance, and collaborate with designers. Experience with HTML, CSS and testing front-end code is required.

title: Data Analyst

title: Technical Team Lead

Set technical direction, run code-review clinics, write onboarding material and own delivery against agreed milestones. Hands-on skills in Node.js and PostgreSQL are expected, along with agile delivery experience.
